title: A class of nonparametric homogeneity tests on the circle
summary: We develop a unified framework for $c$-sample homogeneity testing on the circle. The proposed class of $c$-sample Sobolev tests generalizes the two-sample Sobolev tests based on uniform scores and encompasses the existing multisample tests as particular cases. We further embed this class into a broader aggregation framework, where the samplewise Sobolev components are combined through general merging functions, including average-type, maximum-type, and interpolating families.
